report.summary: Component with 99 pins (94 signal pads, the 3 × 3 EPAD as pin 95 and four corner GND pads), IO MUX, LP IO MUX and analog functions per GPIO, 8 pin rules (4 strapping, JTAG, USB Serial/JTAG, UART0, LP UART vs LP I2C), the LGA module package with the antenna keep-out, and the generated 3D model. The footprint and 3D geometry were cross-checked against Espressif's own published footprint and STEP model (kicad-libraries, CC-BY-SA 4.0, used as a dimension source only and not redistributed). Check the open questions first, then each pin row in the Pins tab.

open_questions: The antenna-side EPAD pad has a 0.5 × 0.5 mm chamfer on its corner towards the antenna (the land pattern's two "1.3" dimensions are its shortened edges, 1.8 - 0.5; Espressif's STEP agrees, its footprint draws 0.45 mm); the module form draws the pad square, 0.125 mm² more copper.
The antenna keep-out covers only the 22 × 6 mm antenna area; the hardware guidelines want the antenna at the board edge or a 15 mm clearance cut-out, which the board layout must provide.
Peripherals reachable only through the GPIO matrix (UART1+, I2C, LEDC, TWAI, RMT, I2S, ...) are not listed per pin: the TRM chapter is not published yet and the datasheet tables place none of them.
Pin directions of IO MUX functions follow the Type columns where readable; LCD, CAM and GMAC directions were inferred from signal names where the type was not extracted.
NC pins 33-39: the datasheet does not say what they connect to; they are marked device NC.
All three documents are pre-release/preliminary; re-check against the final revision.
The -3U variant (24 mm long, U.FL connector, pin 91 ANT2) is not built; only the -3 with PCB antenna.
